apply.title: Take part in the study
apply.intro: If you are interested in taking part, the first step is a short initial questionnaire completed outside this site.
apply.handoffBody: The initial questionnaire runs on the study's external platform. This page collects no data about you.

handoffStep.consent: First you will read the study information and give your consent. Nothing about you is asked until then, not even your name.
handoffStep.questions: Then you will answer a few questions so we can see whether the study is a fit for you.
handoffStep.contact: If you continue in the process, the study team will get in touch with you.

apply.handoffConsentNote: Consent is given before any personal data is collected. You can stop at any point.
apply.closed: No study is currently open to new participants.
apply.privacyNote: This page does not collect, store or send any personal data. Your answers to the initial questionnaire stay on the study platform, not on this site.

study.footerNote: This page is informational and identical for everyone. It contains no personal data and requires no sign-in.
